title: Coconut-Cranberry Bars with Pecans
description: This coconut-cranberry bars with pecans recipe loads graham cracker crumbs with two types of chocolate chips — white and bittersweet — for a real treat.
ingredients: 1.5 cups sweetened dried cranberries (such as Craisins®)

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease or line a 9x13-inch baking dish with parchment paper.
Combine graham cracker crumbs and butter in a bowl; press into the prepared baking dish.
Stir sweetened condensed milk, cranberries, pecans, coconut, white chocolate chips, and bittersweet chocolate chips together in a bowl; gently spread over graham cracker crust.
Bake in the preheated oven until edges are golden brown, 25 to 28 minutes. Cool on a wire rack.

video.description: You’ll love how easy it is to mix up a batch of these tempting and delicious crowd-pleasing bars. Mix graham cracker crumbs with melted butter and press into a baking dish, then stir dried cranberries with sweetened condensed milk, pecan halves, flaked coconut and a dreamy mixture of white and bittersweet chocolate chips and pour over the crust. Bake until golden, then cool, cut and pass them around for a sweet, tangy and crunchy treat that everyone will love.
